packageRules.description: The node-image template deliberately ships a floating major tag. The shared preset pulls in docker:pinDigests, which would otherwise digest-pin this payload and open a bump PR on every image rebuild — each one driving a release and a republish of both templates. Digest pinning is the *consumer's* Renovate's job: they get renovate.json via optionalPaths. It would also break the PR smoke test, which local-tags this exact reference.
